description: Source code for 'git blame' and 'git annotate' commands, including functions for parsing commit info, handling blame entries, output formatting, and configuration.

classes.name: commit_info
classes.description: Structure holding commit author and committer details, including timestamps and summaries.

classes.name: progress_info
classes.description: Structure for tracking progress during blame computation, including progress object and blamed lines count.

methods.name: get_ac_line
methods.description: Parses author or committer line from commit object buffer, extracting name, email, timestamp, and timezone.

methods.name: commit_info_destroy
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for commit_info fields.

methods.name: get_commit_info
methods.description: Populates commit_info structure with details from a commit object.

methods.name: write_filename_info
methods.description: Outputs filename and previous filename info for a blame suspect.

methods.name: emit_one_suspect_detail
methods.description: Outputs detailed commit info for a suspect, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: found_guilty_entry
methods.description: Outputs blame entry details in incremental mode, including suspect info and progress update.

methods.name: format_time
methods.description: Formats timestamp and timezone into a human-readable string, with options for raw or formatted output.

methods.name: emit_porcelain_details
methods.description: Outputs detailed suspect info for porcelain format, including filename info.

methods.name: emit_porcelain_per_line_details
methods.description: Outputs per-line blame details such as unblamable or ignored lines.

methods.name: emit_porcelain
methods.description: Outputs blame entries in porcelain format, including commit and line info.

methods.name: parse_color_fields
methods.description: Parses color configuration string into age-based color mapping.

methods.name: setup_default_color_by_age
methods.description: Initializes default color scheme based on age.

methods.name: determine_line_heat
methods.description: Determines line heat color based on commit author time and color scheme.

methods.name: emit_other
methods.description: Outputs blame info in non-porcelain format, including detailed line annotations.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs all blame entries in either porcelain or other format.

methods.name: read_ancestry
methods.description: Reads graft file to add fake parent commits for blame.

methods.name: update_auto_abbrev
methods.description: Calculates the shortest unique abbreviation for a commit hash.

methods.name: find_alignment
methods.description: Calculates maximum widths for line numbers, authors, filenames, and scores for aligned output.

methods.name: sanity_check_on_fail
methods.description: Performs sanity check and outputs blame info before failing.

methods.name: parse_score
methods.description: Parses a score value from string input.

methods.name: add_prefix
methods.description: Prepends prefix to a given path.

methods.name: git_blame_config
methods.description: Handles repository configuration variables related to blame.

methods.name: blame_copy_callback
methods.description: Callback to set blame copy scoring options.

methods.name: blame_move_callback
methods.description: Callback to set blame move scoring options.

methods.name: blame_diff_algorithm_minimal
methods.description: Sets diff algorithm to minimal.

methods.name: blame_diff_algorithm_callback
methods.description: Sets diff algorithm based on user input.

methods.name: is_a_rev
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid revision.

methods.name: peel_to_commit_oid
methods.description: Peels a tag or object to a commit object ID.

methods.name: build_ignorelist
methods.description: Builds ignore list of revisions for blame.

methods.name: cmd_blame
methods.description: Main function implementing 'git blame' command, parsing options, preparing revisions, and outputting blame info.
